# Bosun SOP This is the list of procedures, responsibilities, and duties of the [color=#846326]Bosun[/color] of this station.
The Bosun is a senior role to all other [color=#846326]Cargo[/color] personnel except the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Quartermaster[/bold][/color].
When selecting an Acting QM, the Bosun should be considered above all other Cargo staff. Should the QM become incapacitated, the Bosun should assume the role of acting head as soon as is convenient for the situation. The Bosun as an acting head will fully assume the associated responsibilities, including ensuring the efficacy of the department as a whole instead of solely focusing on training.
The Bosun shares all responsibilities of other Cargo staff but is to prioritize training, directing, and advising their staff, even during station-threatening events. To this end, the appropriate role's SOP should be consulted depending on whom the Bosun instructs. Mind that the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Quartermaster[/bold][/color]'s orders are final on how the department will operate and what orders must be followed. Failure to perform these priorities or to act as a role model is grounds for demotion.
1. The Bosun is expected to instruct [color=#846326]Logistics Assistants[/color] on how to perform their duties and to guide other Cargo personnel should they ask for help. [bold]Logistics Assistants are to be prioritized first[/bold], but should the assistant decline help, the Bosun does not need to focus their attention on them. The Bosun should be open-minded to all available methods when teaching staff, even if it may not be the most familiar to the Bosun.
2. The Bosun is expected to fulfill the duties of other Cargo personnel [bold]if and only if[/bold] there are no Logistics Assistants needing to be instructed. In addition, when assuming other duties, the Bosun is expected to follow the same SOP as the role they will perform.
3. The Bosun is expected to have a comprehensive understanding of the SOP and duties of each departmental role and may be consulted at any time regarding proper procedure. Additionally, the Bosun must ensure their department is following SOP and is expected to remind staff and/or the department head to do so.
4. The Bosun should be clearly distinguishable from other staff of their department, meaning that they ought to wear the appropriately designated clothing for their role. Consequently, the Bosun should not give to other personnel any Nanotrasen property assigned to them except for instructional use or in case of station-threatening emergency.
5. The Bosun is permitted to seize equipment, apparel, and shuttlecraft for the sake of training. However, this request may be refused if there is an urgent need or if it would be unwise at that moment. Unreasonable refusal to turn over equipment is grounds for disciplinary action should the department head find it necessary.
6. The Bosun is only permitted to act as a [color=#846326]Salvage Specialist[/color] when teaching a Salvage Specialist or during extenuating circumstances where there are zero available Salvage Specialists and no other personnel need help. Should a workplace accident occur and a [color=#846326]Salvage Specialist[/color] become incapacitated, the [color=#846326]Bosun[/color] is permitted to direct rescue efforts up to and including leaving the station.
